gloss: cancellation of a contract; breach of contract

definitions.gloss: cancellation of a contract; contract termination; breach of contract
definitions.explanation: The act of canceling, voiding, or breaking a contract. Can refer to either a lawful termination or an unlawful breach.

examples.japanese: {契約破棄|けいやくはき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}た→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧。
examples.english: I requested cancellation of the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一方的|いっぽうてき}→一方的：17695_ippouteki⟧な{契約破棄|けいやくはき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{損害賠償|そんがいばいしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Unilateral contract cancellation may be subject to damages.

examples.japanese: {相手方|あいてがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{契約違反|けいやくいはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{契約破棄|けいやくはき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通告|つうこく}→通告：20432_tsuukoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I notified the other party of the contract cancellation due to their breach.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (contract) and ⟦{破棄|はき}→破棄：08642_haki⟧ (annulment, cancellation). Used in legal and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約破棄|けいやくはき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通告|つうこく}→通告：20432_tsuukoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to notify of contract cancellation)
- ⟦{一方的|いっぽうてき}→一方的：17695_ippouteki⟧な{契約破棄|けいやくはき} (unilateral contract cancellation)
- {契約破棄|けいやくはき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ (reason for contract cancellation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契約解除|けいやくかいじょ}: contract termination — more formal legal term for lawful cancellation
- {契約違反|けいやくいはん}: breach of contract — the act of violating contract terms
